instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Corporate finance advisory boutique specializing in M&A, capital raising, and valuation services for technology and healthcare companies in the $5M-$100M deal range. Completed 14 transactions in the last 18 months, focusing heavily on cross-border financing solutions. They maintain a lean structure emphasizing high-touch client relationships but are increasingly struggling to scale their proprietary due diligence models.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: We are the incumbent market leader but face increasing pressure from 2 well-funded new entrants who are undercutting our pricing and offering a more modern customer experience. Our priority is defending our installed base – reducing churn, strengthening switching costs, and matching the digital experience our competitors offer without triggering a destructive price war.
answers.additionalContext: We underwent a significant restructuring 6 months ago, consolidating 5 business units into 3 and reducing headcount by 12%. The remaining teams are stretched thin managing the same workload with fewer people. Morale has stabilized but is still recovering. Any innovation initiative must be achievable without adding burden to already-overloaded teams and should visibly improve their daily work experience.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Pre-Deal Risk Scoring Platform
opportunities.rationale: Given the high competitive pressure and current partial innovation process, developing a sophisticated AI tool for automated due diligence and risk scoring can enhance service quality without requiring massive operational overhaul. This directly addresses the need to match modern digital experiences.

first_actions: Hire one specialized Data Science consultant (contract)
Integrate existing CRM data with a predictive analytics module
Allocate 10% of annual operational budget for pilot development
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average due diligence cycle time by 25% and improved client satisfaction scores (+10%)
milestones: MVP defined and scope locked within Q1
Pilot launched with three key clients within Q2
Full rollout feasibility study completed by Q3

opportunities.title: Hyper-Personalized Client Subscription Service (FinTech Layer)
opportunities.rationale: To defend against modern entrants, Titan should explore shifting from purely advisory services to a subscription model offering tailored, automated compliance and portfolio management tools for their existing client base. This radical shift creates high switching costs by embedding proprietary tech directly into the value proposition.

first_actions: Establish a small 'Future Products' task force
Conduct market research on competitor subscription pricing models
Develop a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for basic automated reporting within existing tech stack
resources_needed: Legal counsel specializing in FinTech licensing
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 15% recurring revenue from subscription services within 3 years
milestones: Feasibility study and regulatory pathway assessment by Q1
Beta launch of the basic reporting module in Q4
Final product roadmap locked based on user adoption data

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated, cross-functional 'Market Defense' steering committee to prioritize innovation spend.
Conduct a comprehensive audit of current technology stack integration complexity and identify one high-leverage legacy system replacement project.

key_weaknesses: Inconsistent innovation pipeline due to partial process management.
Severe talent constraint: Small team stretched thin, preventing deep focus on R&D.
Budgetary inflexibility: 23% budget is insufficient for bold, long-term strategic investments without significant external funding or radical restructuring.
